hero.headline: Your freight, moving on a straight line.
hero.subhead: Vijay Roadlines runs FTL and PTL truck freight across the NCR region — full loads, part loads, and reserve vehicles on standby for the day nothing goes to plan.

about.body1: We're guided by three things: cost, quality of service, and getting there on time. That's it — practiced consistently by a team that has spent years doing nothing but FTL and PTL transportation.
about.body2: In just over three years we've become one of the transportation names companies in the NCR region actually rely on — not the cheapest quote, but the one that shows up.
about.body3: Alongside our regular fleet we keep 10–15 vehicles in reserve, ready to move the moment a breakdown, roadblock, or traffic snarl threatens a delivery window. Every vehicle on the road carries GPS tracking, a first-aid box, FASTag, and a toolbox — because a shipment shouldn't stop for something we could have planned for.

why.title: Multi-modal delivery, honest pricing
why.text: FTL, PTL, and part-route combinations priced on the actual load — not a flat quote that pads the difference.

why.title: Transportation, not a side business
why.text: This is the only thing we do. Every route, every driver, every vehicle exists for freight.

why.title: Safety and security as standard
why.text: Insured loads, verified drivers, and vehicles fitted with GPS from pickup to delivery.

why.title: A team that's driven this before
why.text: Our chauffeurs and drivers know the NCR corridors — the shortcuts, the checkpoints, and the hours to avoid.

why.title: Reserve capacity when it matters
why.text: 10–15 standby vehicles mean a breakdown on your route is our problem to solve, not yours to explain.

why.title: We keep the promises we make
why.text: If we quote a delivery window, we plan the route backward from it — not the other way around.

process.title: You share the load
process.text: Tell us origin, destination, weight, and timeline — a call, WhatsApp, or the form on this site all work.

process.title: We assign the vehicle
process.text: From 1-ton pickups to 40-ft trailers, we match the truck to the freight, not the other way around.

process.title: GPS-tracked transit
process.text: Every vehicle is tracked in transit, with a reserve fleet ready if the road gets in the way.

process.title: Delivered, on schedule
process.text: Proof of delivery and a straight answer if anything changed en route.

clientsNote: Customers who've used our services come back for the next one — that repeat business is the actual scorecard we track.
